audit_status.source_base: Greek 1 Corinthians text tradition, draft aligned to public-domain comparison layer later
audit_status.review_note: Compact complete draft reviewed for opening, no lack in grace-gift, divisions, baptism/factions, cross as foolishness/power, wisdom overturned, boasting in Lord.

verses.restored: Paul, called as apostle of Messiah Jesus through the will of the Divine, and Sosthenes the sibling,

familiar.text: Paul, called to be an apostle of Jesus Christ through the will of God, and Sosthenes our brother,

modern.text: Paul, called to be an apostle of Christ Jesus by the will of God, and our brother Sosthenes,

original.text: Παῦλος κλητὸς ἀπόστολος ⸂Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ⸃ διὰ θελήματος θεοῦ καὶ Σωσθένης ὁ ἀδελφὸς

verses.restored: to the assembly of the Divine that is in Corinth, to those sanctified in Messiah Jesus, called holy ones, with all those in every place calling upon the name of our Lord Jesus Messiah, both theirs and ours:

familiar.text: Unto the church of God which is at Corinth, to them that are sanctified in Christ Jesus, called to be saints, with all that in every place call upon the name of Jesus Christ our Lord, both theirs and ours:

modern.text: To the church of God in Corinth, to those sanctified in Christ Jesus and called to be holy, together with all those everywhere who call on the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, their Lord and ours:

original.text: τῇ ἐκκλησίᾳ τοῦ θεοῦ, ⸂ἡγιασμένοις ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ, τῇ οὔσῃ ἐν Κορίνθῳ,⸃ κλητοῖς ἁγίοις, σὺν πᾶσιν τοῖς ἐπικαλουμένοις τὸ ὄνομα τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ ἐν παντὶ τόπῳ ⸀αὐτῶν καὶ ἡμῶν·

verses.restored: Grace to you and peace from Divine our Father and Lord Jesus Messiah.

familiar.text: Grace be unto you, and peace, from God our Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ.

modern.text: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ. Thanksgiving (Philippians 1:3–11; Colossians 1:3–14)

original.text: χάρις ὑμῖν καὶ εἰρήνη ἀπὸ θεοῦ πατρὸς ἡμῶν καὶ κυρίου Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ.

verses.restored: I thank my Divine always concerning you for the grace of the Divine given to you in Messiah Jesus,

familiar.text: I thank my God always on your behalf, for the grace of God which is given you by Jesus Christ;

modern.text: I always thank my God for you because of the grace He has given you in Christ Jesus.

original.text: Εὐχαριστῶ τῷ θεῷ ⸀μου πάντοτε περὶ ὑμῶν ἐπὶ τῇ χάριτι τοῦ θεοῦ τῇ δοθείσῃ ὑμῖν ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ,

verses.restored: because in everything you were enriched in him, in every word and all knowledge,

familiar.text: That in every thing ye are enriched by him, in all utterance, and in all knowledge;

modern.text: For in Him you have been enriched in every way, in all speech and all knowledge,

original.text: ὅτι ἐν παντὶ ἐπλουτίσθητε ἐν αὐτῷ, ἐν παντὶ λόγῳ καὶ πάσῃ γνώσει,

verses.restored: just as the witness of Messiah was confirmed among you,

familiar.text: Even as the testimony of Christ was confirmed in you:

modern.text: because our testimony about Christ was confirmed in you.

original.text: καθὼς τὸ μαρτύριον τοῦ Χριστοῦ ἐβεβαιώθη ἐν ὑμῖν,

verses.restored: so that you are not lacking in any grace-gift as you await the unveiling of our Lord Jesus Messiah,

familiar.text: So that ye come behind in no gift; waiting for the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ:

modern.text: Therefore you do not lack any spiritual gift as you eagerly await the revelation of our Lord Jesus Christ.

original.text: ὥστε ὑμᾶς μὴ ὑστερεῖσθαι ἐν μηδενὶ χαρίσματι, ἀπεκδεχομένους τὴν ἀποκάλυψιν τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ·

verses.restored: who will also confirm you until the end, blameless in the day of our Lord Jesus Messiah.

familiar.text: Who shall also confirm you unto the end, that ye may be blameless in the day of our Lord Jesus Christ.

modern.text: He will sustain you to the end, so that you will be blameless on the day of our Lord Jesus Christ.

original.text: ὃς καὶ βεβαιώσει ὑμᾶς ἕως τέλους ἀνεγκλήτους ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ.

verses.restored: Trustworthy is the Divine, through whom you were called into fellowship/participation of his Son, Jesus Messiah our Lord.

familiar.text: God is faithful, by whom ye were called unto the fellowship of his Son Jesus Christ our Lord.

modern.text: God, who has called you into fellowship with His Son Jesus Christ our Lord, is faithful. Unity in the Church (Psalms 133:1–3; Ephesians 4:1–16)

original.text: πιστὸς ὁ θεὸς διʼ οὗ ἐκλήθητε εἰς κοινωνίαν τοῦ υἱοῦ αὐτοῦ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν.

verses.restored: I urge you, siblings, through the name of our Lord Jesus Messiah, that you all speak the same thing, and that there be no splits among you, but that you be restored together in the same mind and the same discernment.

familiar.text: Now I beseech you, brethren, by the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that ye all speak the same thing, and that there be no divisions among you; but that ye be perfectly joined together in the same mind and in the same judgment.

modern.text: I appeal to you, brothers, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that all of you agree together, so that there may be no divisions among you and that you may be united in mind and conviction.

original.text: Παρακαλῶ δὲ ὑμᾶς, ἀδελφοί, διὰ τοῦ ὀνόματος τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ ἵνα τὸ αὐτὸ λέγητε πάντες, καὶ μὴ ᾖ ἐν ὑμῖν σχίσματα, ἦτε δὲ κατηρτισμένοι ἐν τῷ αὐτῷ νοῒ καὶ ἐν τῇ αὐτῇ γνώμῃ.

verses.restored: For it was made clear to me concerning you, my siblings, by those of Chloe, that there are strifes among you.

familiar.text: For it hath been declared unto me of you, my brethren, by them which are of the house of Chloe, that there are contentions among you.

modern.text: My brothers, some from Chloe’s household have informed me that there are quarrels among you.

original.text: ἐδηλώθη γάρ μοι περὶ ὑμῶν, ἀδελφοί μου, ὑπὸ τῶν Χλόης ὅτι ἔριδες ἐν ὑμῖν εἰσιν.

verses.restored: I mean this: each of you says, I am of Paul; I of Apollos; I of Cephas; I of Messiah.

familiar.text: Now this I say, that every one of you saith, I am of Paul; and I of Apollos; and I of Cephas; and I of Christ.

modern.text: What I mean is this: Individuals among you are saying, “I follow Paul,” “I follow Apollos,” “I follow Cephas,” or “I follow Christ.”

original.text: λέγω δὲ τοῦτο ὅτι ἕκαστος ὑμῶν λέγει· Ἐγὼ μέν εἰμι Παύλου, Ἐγὼ δὲ Ἀπολλῶ, Ἐγὼ δὲ Κηφᾶ, Ἐγὼ δὲ Χριστοῦ.

verses.restored: Has Messiah been divided? Was Paul crucified for you? Or were you baptized into the name of Paul?

familiar.text: Is Christ divided? was Paul crucified for you? or were ye baptized in the name of Paul?

modern.text: Is Christ divided? Was Paul crucified for you? Were you baptized into the name of Paul?

original.text: μεμέρισται ὁ Χριστός; μὴ Παῦλος ἐσταυρώθη ὑπὲρ ὑμῶν, ἢ εἰς τὸ ὄνομα Παύλου ἐβαπτίσθητε;

verses.restored: I thank the Divine that I baptized none of you except Crispus and Gaius,

familiar.text: I thank God that I baptized none of you, but Crispus and Gaius;

modern.text: I thank God that I did not baptize any of you except Crispus and Gaius,

original.text: ⸀εὐχαριστῶ ὅτι οὐδένα ὑμῶν ἐβάπτισα εἰ μὴ Κρίσπον καὶ Γάϊον,

verses.restored: so that no one may say you were baptized into my name.

familiar.text: Lest any should say that I had baptized in mine own name.

modern.text: so no one can say that you were baptized into my name.

original.text: ἵνα μή τις εἴπῃ ὅτι εἰς τὸ ἐμὸν ὄνομα ⸀ἐβαπτίσθητε·

verses.restored: I also baptized the household of Stephanas; beyond that I do not know whether I baptized anyone else.

familiar.text: And I baptized also the household of Stephanas: besides, I know not whether I baptized any other.

modern.text: Yes, I also baptized the household of Stephanas; beyond that I do not remember if I baptized anyone else.

original.text: ἐβάπτισα δὲ καὶ τὸν Στεφανᾶ οἶκον· λοιπὸν οὐκ οἶδα εἴ τινα ἄλλον ἐβάπτισα.

verses.restored: For Messiah did not send me to baptize, but to announce good news, not in wisdom of word, so that the cross of Messiah might not be emptied.

familiar.text: For Christ sent me not to baptize, but to preach the gospel: not with wisdom of words, lest the cross of Christ should be made of none effect.

modern.text: For Christ did not send me to baptize, but to preach the gospel, not with words of wisdom, lest the cross of Christ be emptied of its power. The Message of the Cross

original.text: οὐ γὰρ ἀπέστειλέν με Χριστὸς βαπτίζειν ἀλλὰ εὐαγγελίζεσθαι, οὐκ ἐν σοφίᾳ λόγου, ἵνα μὴ κενωθῇ ὁ σταυρὸς τοῦ Χριστοῦ.

verses.restored: For the word of the cross is foolishness to those perishing, but to us being saved/healed it is power of the Divine.

familiar.text: For the preaching of the cross is to them that perish foolishness; but unto us which are saved it is the power of God.

modern.text: For the message of the cross is foolishness to those who are perishing, but to us who are being saved it is the power of God.

original.text: Ὁ λόγος γὰρ ὁ τοῦ σταυροῦ τοῖς μὲν ἀπολλυμένοις μωρία ἐστίν, τοῖς δὲ σῳζομένοις ἡμῖν δύναμις θεοῦ ἐστιν.

verses.restored: For it is written: I will destroy the wisdom of the wise, and the understanding of the understanding ones I will set aside.

familiar.text: For it is written, I will destroy the wisdom of the wise, and will bring to nothing the understanding of the prudent.

modern.text: For it is written: “I will destroy the wisdom of the wise; the intelligence of the intelligent I will frustrate.”

original.text: γέγραπται γάρ· Ἀπολῶ τὴν σοφίαν τῶν σοφῶν, καὶ τὴν σύνεσιν τῶν συνετῶν ἀθετήσω.

verses.restored: Where is the wise one? Where is the scribe? Where is the debater of this age? Did not the Divine make foolish the wisdom of the world?

familiar.text: Where is the wise? where is the scribe? where is the disputer of this world? hath not God made foolish the wisdom of this world?

modern.text: Where is the wise man? Where is the scribe? Where is the philosopher of this age? Has not God made foolish the wisdom of the world?

original.text: ποῦ σοφός; ποῦ γραμματεύς; ποῦ συζητητὴς τοῦ αἰῶνος τούτου; οὐχὶ ἐμώρανεν ὁ θεὸς τὴν σοφίαν τοῦ ⸀κόσμου;

verses.restored: For since in the wisdom of the Divine the world through wisdom did not know the Divine, the Divine was pleased through the foolishness of proclamation to save/heal those trusting.

familiar.text: For after that in the wisdom of God the world by wisdom knew not God, it pleased God by the foolishness of preaching to save them that believe.

modern.text: For since in the wisdom of God the world through its wisdom did not know Him, God was pleased through the foolishness of what was preached to save those who believe.

original.text: ἐπειδὴ γὰρ ἐν τῇ σοφίᾳ τοῦ θεοῦ οὐκ ἔγνω ὁ κόσμος διὰ τῆς σοφίας τὸν θεόν, εὐδόκησεν ὁ θεὸς διὰ τῆς μωρίας τοῦ κηρύγματος σῶσαι τοὺς πιστεύοντας.

verses.restored: Since Judeans ask for signs and Greeks seek wisdom,

familiar.text: For the Jews require a sign, and the Greeks seek after wisdom:

modern.text: Jews demand signs and Greeks search for wisdom,

original.text: ἐπειδὴ καὶ Ἰουδαῖοι ⸀σημεῖα αἰτοῦσιν καὶ Ἕλληνες σοφίαν ζητοῦσιν·

verses.restored: but we proclaim Messiah crucified, to Judeans a stumbling block and to nations foolishness,

familiar.text: But we preach Christ crucified, unto the Jews a stumblingblock, and unto the Greeks foolishness;

modern.text: but we preach Christ crucified, a stumbling block to Jews and foolishness to Gentiles,

original.text: ἡμεῖς δὲ κηρύσσομεν Χριστὸν ἐσταυρωμένον, Ἰουδαίοις μὲν σκάνδαλον ⸀ἔθνεσιν δὲ μωρίαν,

verses.restored: but to those called, both Judeans and Greeks, Messiah power of the Divine and wisdom of the Divine.

familiar.text: But unto them which are called, both Jews and Greeks, Christ the power of God, and the wisdom of God.

modern.text: but to those who are called, both Jews and Greeks, Christ the power of God and the wisdom of God.

original.text: αὐτοῖς δὲ τοῖς κλητοῖς, Ἰουδαίοις τε καὶ Ἕλλησιν, Χριστὸν θεοῦ δύναμιν καὶ θεοῦ σοφίαν.

verses.restored: Because the foolishness of the Divine is wiser than humans, and the weakness of the Divine is stronger than humans.

familiar.text: Because the foolishness of God is wiser than men; and the weakness of God is stronger than men.

modern.text: For the foolishness of God is wiser than man’s wisdom, and the weakness of God is stronger than man’s strength. Wisdom from God

original.text: ὅτι τὸ μωρὸν τοῦ θεοῦ σοφώτερον τῶν ἀνθρώπων ἐστίν, καὶ τὸ ἀσθενὲς τοῦ θεοῦ ἰσχυρότερον τῶν ⸀ἀνθρώπων.

verses.restored: For see your calling, siblings: not many wise according to flesh, not many powerful, not many well-born.

familiar.text: For ye see your calling, brethren, how that not many wise men after the flesh, not many mighty, not many noble, are called:

modern.text: Brothers, consider the time of your calling: Not many of you were wise by human standards; not many were powerful; not many were of noble birth.

original.text: Βλέπετε γὰρ τὴν κλῆσιν ὑμῶν, ἀδελφοί, ὅτι οὐ πολλοὶ σοφοὶ κατὰ σάρκα, οὐ πολλοὶ δυνατοί, οὐ πολλοὶ εὐγενεῖς·

verses.restored: But the foolish things of the world the Divine chose to shame the wise; and the weak things of the world the Divine chose to shame the strong.

familiar.text: But God hath chosen the foolish things of the world to confound the wise; and God hath chosen the weak things of the world to confound the things which are mighty;

modern.text: But God chose the foolish things of the world to shame the wise; God chose the weak things of the world to shame the strong.

original.text: ἀλλὰ τὰ μωρὰ τοῦ κόσμου ἐξελέξατο ὁ θεός, ἵνα ⸂καταισχύνῃ τοὺς σοφούς⸃, καὶ τὰ ἀσθενῆ τοῦ κόσμου ἐξελέξατο ὁ θεός, ἵνα καταισχύνῃ τὰ ἰσχυρά,

verses.restored: The low-born things of the world and the despised the Divine chose, the things that are not, to make inactive the things that are,

familiar.text: And base things of the world, and things which are despised, hath God chosen, yea, and things which are not, to bring to nought things that are:

modern.text: He chose the lowly and despised things of the world, and the things that are not, to nullify the things that are,

original.text: καὶ τὰ ἀγενῆ τοῦ κόσμου καὶ τὰ ἐξουθενημένα ἐξελέξατο ὁ θεός, ⸀τὰ μὴ ὄντα, ἵνα τὰ ὄντα καταργήσῃ,

verses.restored: so that no flesh might boast before the Divine.

familiar.text: That no flesh should glory in his presence.

modern.text: so that no one may boast in His presence.

original.text: ὅπως μὴ καυχήσηται πᾶσα σὰρξ ἐνώπιον τοῦ θεοῦ.

verses.restored: From him you are in Messiah Jesus, who became wisdom to us from the Divine, and righteousness/justice and sanctification and redemption/release,

familiar.text: But of him are ye in Christ Jesus, who of God is made unto us wisdom, and righteousness, and sanctification, and redemption:

modern.text: It is because of Him that you are in Christ Jesus, who has become for us wisdom from God: our righteousness, holiness, and redemption.

original.text: ἐξ αὐτοῦ δὲ ὑμεῖς ἐστε ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ, ὃς ἐγενήθη ⸂σοφία ἡμῖν⸃ ἀπὸ θεοῦ, δικαιοσύνη τε καὶ ἁγιασμὸς καὶ ἀπολύτρωσις,

verses.restored: so that, just as it is written: Let the one boasting boast in the Lord.

familiar.text: That, according as it is written, He that glorieth, let him glory in the Lord.

modern.text: Therefore, as it is written: “Let him who boasts boast in the Lord.”

original.text: ἵνα καθὼς γέγραπται· Ὁ καυχώμενος ἐν κυρίῳ καυχάσθω.

translation_notes: Schisma is rendered split/division to preserve body-fracture language.
The cross is framed as power and wisdom that overturn status competition, not as a slogan for anti-intellectualism.
